description:
We’re building a health monitoring application for astronauts, focusing on usability, meaningful health insights, and effective decision support.

I'm a product designer, and I'll be contributing to product strategy, UX, UI, and AI-assisted development.

Looking for teammates with experience or interest in software development, data science, biomedical engineering, human physiology, NASA datasets, data visualization, or health monitoring systems.

All experience levels are welcome.
